versions.changelog:
Initial release of the score-analysis skill.

- Analyze class exam scores and generate visual reports and professional Word reports.
- Supports longitudinal comparison across multiple exams and horizontal comparison with peer classes.
- Auto-detects Excel/CSV headers and validates data before analysis.
- Identifies critical students, detects subject imbalance, and creates grouped radar charts.
- Outputs standardized data, analysis results, charts, and optional presentation PPTs.
- Customizable branding and flexible handling of special exam cases.
